bass.tags: Funk-rock instrumental featuring a prominent, syncopated electric bassline with a bright, percussive tone. The bass plays a repetitive sixteenth-note riff emphasizing the root and octave. A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic staccato scratches and muted strums on the off-beats. The drum kit maintains a steady groove with a crisp snare and tight hi-hat patterns. A subtle, low-frequency synthesizer pad provides harmonic depth in the background. The tempo is 110 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the bass and the dry, punchy drum production.

[Intro]

[tight drum kit with closed hi-hats]

[staccato muted electric guitar scratches]

A high-gain bass guitar doubles the guitar riff, providing a thick low-end. The drum kit consists of a punchy kick drum, a crisp snare hitting on beats two and four, and consistent eighth-note hi-hat patterns. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement is centered around a repetitive, driving instrumental groove with a raw, live-room production aesthetic. The guitar tone is saturated with mid-range bite and sustain. The overall structure is a continuous loop of the main riff with minor variations in drum fills.
